decisive_items: a solid, well-demarcated, hyperechoic, hypoperfused 1.3 × 1.1 cm mass at the tail of the right epididymis
a painless, round, hazelnut-sized mass localized to the tail of the right epididymis
response.rationale: Adenomatoid tumor is the classic benign solid epididymal mass; the ultrasound explicitly describes a solid, well-demarcated, hypoperfused mass, whereas epididymal cysts and spermatoceles are cystic lesions, not solid hyperechoic masses.

rejected.why: Epididymal cyst is a cystic lesion, contradicted by the solid, hyperechoic, hypoperfused imaging appearance.
Spermatocele is a cystic epididymal retention cyst, inconsistent with the solid, well-demarcated mass described.
